method: The acceptance functions were read after the edit and the negative tests call those functions. A Markdown sentence was not treated as a control.

findings.control: build_acquisition_environment rejects inherited mappings and returns an allowlisted mapping
prepare_acquisition and commit_acquisition call authorize_url. commit has no socket sender.
findings.remaining_limitation: A live HTTPS client was not implemented. Pip is not claimed to enforce this redirect policy.

findings.control: assess_wheel_candidate rejects sdists, bad tags, yanked releases, and prereleases before commit
verify_wheelhouse calls inspect_wheel_bytes and rejects a non-ZIP payload after a hash match
verify_wheelhouse calls assert_dependency_graph. accept_verified_lock refuses unproven provenance.
findings.remaining_limitation: The production transitive graph is still unknown because no real wheels exist.

findings.control: parse_requirement_line rejects URL and VCS forms and preserves markers. prepare_acquisition uses parse_requirement_document.
os.lstat rejects links before use. create_exclusive_file uses O_EXCL.
findings.remaining_limitation: A concurrent parent-directory replacement is not fully excluded.

findings.control: The modules still do not import a network client. Import was not given a new side effect.
